historical_orphan_assay.query: WITH sample AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,vehicle_id FROM public.vehicle_observations ORDER BY id LIMIT 200) SELECT count(*) AS sampled_rows,count(s.vehicle_id) AS nonnull_vehicle_refs,count(v.id) AS existing_targets,count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.vehicle_id IS NOT NULL AND v.id IS NULL) AS sampled_orphans FROM sample s LEFT JOIN public.vehicles v ON v.id=s.vehicle_id;
historical_orphan_assay.method: Deterministic convenience sample by primary-key order; not random or a population estimate; no whole-log scan.
historical_orphan_assay.action: Preserve immutable rows; no NULLing, deletion, guessed vehicle or source-body backfill. Validate the new FK only after a separately bounded historical resolution audit.

property_registry.source_representation: structured_data.property/value are raw source-grain labels and values, not canonical property edges.

reuse_candidates.caution: Model year only; not manufacture year. YouTube media is outside current applies_to_kinds.
Class reference in speech is not automatically this chassis model.
Each reading remains a separate time/source claim; TMU and actual mileage are different qualifiers.
Registry unit is liters; preserve raw 427 ci and perform a cited conversion at projection time, never store 427 as liters.
